title: Talon (Esperia, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Talon is a single-seat light fighter from Esperia in Star Citizen, a copy of a warship of the alien Tevarin. It has directional shields and weak armour, so the shield buttons on the left stick base matter more here than on ships with a round shield.

panels.name: Talon: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Talon's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (two size-4 guns)
controls.text: The Talon has two medium-size guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (four missiles)
controls.text: The Talon carries four missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Phalanx shields
controls.text: The Talon's shields cover separate directions instead of one bubble.
controls.context: The pilot strengthens the side facing the enemy with the shield buttons 12 to 16 on the left stick base.
